public_rationale: METR states that a 50% time horizon does not mean tasks below that duration can be delegated to AI [e1]. Its note describes differences between benchmark tasks and real work, including required context and how clearly tasks are defined [e1]. The duration refers to human baseline completion time, not model runtime [e1]. These methodological restrictions apply to the May 8 graph and support Marcus's inference limit: it does not establish dependable performance across most human activities taking 16 hours [e1].
limitations: The evidence describes limits of the metric, not a separate measurement of Mythos's capabilities [e1].
It does not establish that Mythos cannot perform activities beyond the benchmark.
It does not measure performance on a representative sample of most human activities or establish an exact reliability threshold.
